He’s a total sweetheart with a heart of gold. He still has plenty of playful puppy energy and gets the zoomies often, but his favorite thing in the world? Being with his people. 🥰 Whether he’s carrying his favorite blanket from room to room, following you around the house, or soaking up every ounce of attention he can get, this boy is always smiling. Zeus is very smart and loves to work. He’s fully obedience trained, attends Rally classes, and truly shines with structure and purpose. Highly food motivated, he’s eager to learn, loves to please, and is an absolute dream for anyone who enjoys training dogs. He has been obedience trained in both English and French.  He gets along wonderfully with all of our dogs, and absolutely loves kids. Because of his play style, he does best with dogs 30 pounds and up. He would thrive with an adopter who has working-breed experience and is excited to continue giving him structure, training, and plenty of adventures. He is crate trained, X-pen trained, house trained, neutered, vaccinated, and more than ready to find his forever family. 💛 Just a few months ago, Zeus was sitting in a shelter after his family moved away. Three days later, he was scheduled to be euthanized. Thankfully, the incredible team at Weird Rescue saw what everyone who meets him sees, a goofy, loving dog who simply needed someone to believe in him. Watching Zeus embrace his second chance has been one of the greatest privileges, and we know his perfect family is out there. Braised Chicken Legs with Rice, Potatoes & Veggies🍗 Ingredients * 1 package chicken drumsticks (6–7 pieces) * 1-2 tbsp olive oil * 1 tsp salt * 1 tsp black pepper * 2 tsp garlic powder * 2 tsp onion powder * 2 tsp paprika * ½ tsp cumin * 1 jalapeño, diced * ½ red onion, diced * 1 tbsp sun-dried tomato paste * 1 tbsp @Loisa sofrito * 5–6 garlic cloves, minced * 4 cups chicken stock * 1 (8 oz) can tomato sauce * Small potatoes, halved (about 10–12 baby potatoes) * 1 zucchini, diced * Cooked white rice, for serving (let me know if you guys want my rice recipe) Instructions: 1. Clean the chicken with vinegar, then pat completely dry with paper towels. 2. Season the chicken with the salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and cumin. Toss until evenly coated. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven or deep skillet over medium-high heat. 4. Brown the chicken for 2–3 minutes per side until golden. It doesn’t need to be cooked through. Remove and set aside. 5. In the same pot, add the diced jalapeño and red onion. Cook for about 5 minutes until softened. 6. Stir in the sun-dried tomato paste and cook for 30 seconds. 7. Add the Loisa Sofrito and minced garlic. Cook for 1 minute until fragrant. 8. Pour in the chicken stock and tomato sauce, stirring to combine. Bring to a gentle boil. 9. Return the chicken to the pot. Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for about 1 hour, or until the chicken is fall-apart tender and the sauce has reduced. 10. About 20 minutes before the chicken is done, add the halved potatoes and diced zucchini. Continue simmering until the potatoes are fork-tender and the zucchini is cooked. 11. Serve over fluffy white rice and spoon plenty of the sauce over the top. #chickenlegs #braised #onepotmeals #cookwithme

#британский #британскийкот #кот #триада #котакбас Британский кот (британская короткошерстная) — это популярная порода домашних кошек, выведенная в Великобритании в XIX веке. Они известны своим «плюшевым» внешним видом, плотной шерстью, круглыми щеками и спокойным, независимым характером. Внешность: Крупные или средние кошки с крепким костяком и развитой мускулатурой. Лапы короткие и массивные, хвост толстый. Голова круглая с пухлыми щеками и большими выразительными глазами.Шерсть: Короткая, очень густая, с плотным подшерстком, напоминающая плюш. Самый известный окрас — сплошной серый (британский голубой), однако существует около 200 других вариаций (шоколадный, лиловый, белый и др.).Характер: Уравновешенные, интеллигентные и сдержанные.
